desc:
Reduce AI running costs without breaking the features your customers use. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your usage, tests right-sized models, sets spend caps and per-user limits, and gives you a plain cost report and forecast, so a busy week never arrives as a surprise bill.

## Why do AI running costs creep up?

AI usage is billed by the amount of text and images processed, so cost grows with traffic, with the length of your instructions and with the size of the model you chose. Most teams pick a strong model during testing and never revisit the choice. Every question then runs on the most expensive option, even when a simple one would answer just as well.

Other costs hide in plain sight. Long instructions are sent with every request. Identical questions are answered from scratch each time. One heavy user or a runaway script can use a large share of the month's budget in an afternoon.

## What cost control changes

Cost control makes spend predictable, which makes the feature safe to grow. When you know what one answer costs, you can price a plan, decide whether a free tier is affordable and tell your team how much usage is fine.

The mechanism is simple. We measure which features use the most, test whether a smaller model gives answers that are good enough for that job, trim the instructions that are sent each time, and reuse answers to repeated questions. Savings depend on your traffic and your quality bar, so we describe likely wins from your own data rather than promising a figure.

## What a good cost set-up includes

- A usage review by feature, showing which part of your product drives the bill.
- Cost per use worked out in plain terms, such as cost per chat or per summary.
- Side-by-side tests of cheaper model options on your real questions.
- Daily and monthly spend caps set inside your provider account.
- Budget alert emails that arrive before a limit is reached.
- Shorter instructions that keep the same behavior with less text.
- Caching for questions that repeat, so the answer is stored and reused.
- Per-user limits that stop one account from using the whole allowance.
- A forecast for quiet, normal and busy traffic.
- A simple check sheet you can read each month.

## What we do

We begin by reading usage from your provider account, with you inviting us as a team member rather than sharing a login. We list each AI feature and work out what a typical use costs. Then we pick the features where savings are most likely and run your real examples through cheaper options, scoring the answers against the current ones.

The Basic package checks one feature and lists quick savings. The Standard package tests alternative models and sets caps, alerts and shorter instructions. The Premium package adds caching, per-user limits, a forecast for three traffic levels and a handover call. We change settings only where you approve, and we note what each change does so it can be reversed.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Decide what an acceptable answer looks like before comparing models.
- Set a hard monthly cap, even if it feels high.
- Test cheaper options on real customer questions, not invented ones.
- Keep instructions as short as they can be while staying clear.
- Review the cost sheet monthly, especially after a launch or a promotion.

**Avoid:**
- Switching every feature to the cheapest model without testing it.
- Leaving usage open to anonymous visitors with no limit.
- Sending whole documents with every request when a short excerpt would do.
- Ignoring budget alerts because the last one was a false alarm.
- Cutting quality on features that customers rely on to buy.

## Who it is for

A store owner added a shopping assistant and the monthly bill is higher than expected. A software founder runs an in-app chat and wants to offer a free tier without losing money on it. An agency manages several client chatbots and needs one clear view of what each one costs.

## What we need from you

We need to know which AI features you run, which provider account they use and roughly how busy your site or app is. Invite us as a team member with usage viewing rights where your provider allows it, or send exported usage reports instead. Please never share a password. A few real example questions help us test fairly. Server and hosting bills are separate from AI usage, and we will tell you plainly if they are outside this review.
